source_claims_used: EvoPrompt starts from a population and iteratively selects parents, generates offspring with LLM-driven evolutionary operators, evaluates offspring on a development set, and updates the population by scores.
The paper instantiates GA and DE; the GA implementation uses fitness-based parent selection and top-N elitist update over parents plus offspring.

The public implementation requires a runtime, task data and model/API configuration; its README distinguishes the evolution model from the task implementation model and notes a population-size/iteration cost-performance tradeoff.

chat_native_reduction.population_unit: role-local assignment-policy candidate text with stable candidate identity and lineage
chat_native_reduction.mutation: Create one bounded textual variation of an eligible role-local candidate; control, semantic-input, safety and authority fields are immutable and cannot be mutated.
chat_native_reduction.crossover: Combine compatible useful subplans from two eligible role-local parents; the child starts UNEVALUATED and has no score or credit until its own terminal evidence is durably read back.
chat_native_reduction.selection_update: Recovery override first; then filter to safe/evidenced candidates, deduplicate terminal identities, preserve the incumbent on exact value ties, and apply deterministic elitist replacement only after terminal evidence.
chat_native_reduction.de_style_transfer: NOT_LITERAL: numeric donor-difference semantics do not exist for symbolic assignment policies. A textual contrast operator could be explored separately, but is not claimed to reproduce Differential Evolution.

invariants: resume durable pending_switch before any optimizer reselection
deduplicate evaluation/archive entries by stable terminal transition identity
only evidence-backed safe non-protected candidates are eligible while Chat-capable options remain
keep incumbent on exact score tie
award credit only after immutable evidence readback
when all Chat-capable predecessors are complete and the only candidates require protected authority, record downstream_verification_required rather than execute the protected candidate

same_guard_aggregate.comparison_note: OPRO results are the frozen sequence-117 outcomes on the identical guard traces; OPRO was not rerun or retuned in this invocation.

evolution_specific_traces.invariant: an unevaluated mutated child cannot displace an evidenced parent
a crossover child receives no credit before terminal evidence readback
variation cannot mutate authority/safety boundaries; an unsafe child is ineligible
a worse evidenced child does not evict the elite
a better evidenced safe child may replace the worst population member

interpretation_guard: Constructed controller conformance only. This does not reproduce EvoPrompt benchmark results, does not show task-quality improvement, and does not establish that evolutionary variation outperforms OPRO-HIST-SWITCH-v1. The same eight safety/recovery/durability invariants are deliberately held fixed; evolutionary-specific traces only establish that bounded mutation/crossover plus elitist update can be expressed without weakening those guards.
